I could not confirm Jack Doohan's race entries from the search results, so this answer is a best estimate.

The race reports only list the top 10 finishers, and Doohan doesn't appear in any report I retrieved. Searches for his name, for his 2025 races (Australia, China, Japan) and for Colapinto's debut returned only other drivers. Those results also show Alpine as the team in the 2025 races where Doohan is known to have driven, but they don't name him.

From my own knowledge, not from the retrieved material, Doohan's only Formula 1 team in 2000–2025 was Alpine, for which he started a few 2025 rounds before Franco Colapinto took over his seat. That would make the count 1, but please verify it against a full entry list.

ANSWER: 1
